name: app.killbounce.data/tools
title: KillBounce Data
description: Pay-per-call agent tools: web, email, domains, SEC, files, code, images, translation. USDC (x402).

tools.name: email_verify
tools.description: Is this email address real and safe to send to? Returns status (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown, invalid), reason, and 0-100 score. Checks syntax, domain and MX records, asks the mail server whether the mailbox exists (no email is sent), detects catch-all domains, disposable/throwaway providers, role accounts (info@, support@), free providers, and suggests typo fixes (gmial.com -> gmail.com). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: site_check
tools.description: One-call safety and setup audit for a domain: verdict (score + grade + summary) and a ranked list of issues, plus DNS, email security (SPF, DKIM on common selectors, DMARC, MTA-STS), SSL certificate (trust, issuer, expiry, days left, SANs, TLS version), domain age and registrar (RDAP), and HTTP redirect chain with security headers. Flags scam signals like newly registered domains and untrusted certificates. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

domain.description: Domain to audit (a full URL is accepted too)

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA) from public resolvers (Cloudflare, with Google and Quad9 as fallbacks), the domain's IP addresses, the network owner of its first IP (ASN, network name, prefix, country), its HTTP response headers, and a ping summary. One call replaces several lookups. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: markdown
tools.description: Any public URL as clean Markdown: main content only (no nav, ads, footers, scripts), with headings, links, lists, tables, and code kept. Handles articles, docs, plain-text files and PDFs (text-based PDFs only, first 50 pages). Returns title, author, date, word count, and approx token count. Optional max_chars (default 20000, max 100000). Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL, or a PDF/plain-text URL

max_chars.description: Max Markdown characters to return (default 20000, max 100000)

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Structured facts a page declares about itself, so you don't have to read the page: highlights (product price, currency, stock, rating, brand; event dates, venue, address; article headline, author, date; organization, recipe, job posting, FAQ), link preview (title, description, image), canonical URL, language, plus raw OpenGraph, Twitter card, JSON-LD (broken blocks repaired), and microdata. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public http(s) URL of an HTML page

tools.name: diff
tools.description: What changed on a page. First call returns a snapshot_id; call again with since=<snapshot_id> to get only the added, removed, and changed lines (e.g. a price going from $29 to $39) instead of re-reading the page. Snapshots last 30 days. Or pass compare=<second url> to diff two pages directly. Works on HTML, PDFs, and text. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

since.description: snapshot_id from a previous call; returns changes since then

compare.description: Second URL to diff against url directly

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetches a public URL and returns its visible text (up to 15,000 characters) with title, meta description, status code, and final URL after redirects. Scripts, styles, navigation, headers, footers, sidebars and forms are removed. For a cleaner main-content extract with headings and links kept, use /markdown. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: token
tools.description: Price snapshot for a crypto token by symbol, or by contract address on Ethereum or Base: USD price, 24h change, market cap, 24h volume, and market-cap rank, from CoinGecko. Unknown tokens and a busy price service are refused and not charged. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

chain.description: Chain of the contract address: ethereum (default) or base

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: On-chain overview for any Base address: native balance and nonce. One call replaces multiple RPC queries. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: certs
tools.description: Unexpired TLS certificates publicly logged for a domain (Certificate Transparency, via crt.sh with Cert Spotter as backup): subdomains (up to 500) and wildcards found, the 25 newest certificates, issuing authorities with counts, certificates issued in the last 7 days, expiry dates, and flags such as sudden new issuance. Useful for mapping a domain's attack surface or spotting look-alike infrastructure. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: github_tree
tools.description: Compact map of a public GitHub repository for reading code with an LLM: filtered file tree (node_modules, build output and lock files removed), entry points, key config files, largest files with token estimates, total token estimate, languages, stars, license, last push, and the start of the README. Decide what to read before spending tokens. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit (default: the repo's default branch)

tools.name: robots
tools.description: Whether a URL may be fetched by 20 named AI and search agents (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, Googlebot, Bingbot, CCBot, and more), parsed to RFC 9309: the rules group that applied, crawl-delay, sitemaps, Content-Signal preferences, and whether llms.txt or ai.txt exist. Check before crawling, or audit a site's AI policy. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Page URL or domain to check

tools.name: rss
tools.description: Latest items from a site's RSS, Atom, or JSON feed. Give a feed URL or any page: the feed is found automatically. Returns clean titles, links, ISO dates, authors, short plain-text summaries, and categories. Cheaper and more reliable than scraping a blog or news page for new posts. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Feed URL, or a website/blog page to discover the feed from

tools.name: redirects
tools.description: Follows a URL hop by hop (up to 15) without loading the final page's content: status, Location, timing and server for each hop, final URL, and flags for loops, too many hops, HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrades, cross-domain jumps, suspected open redirects, and meta-refresh redirects. Use on short links or tracking links before opening them. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: image_upload
tools.description: Upload an image once (url=, or POST the bytes) and get an image_id for /image-edit. Every edit is re-rendered from this original, so quality never drifts. Returns size, format, colors, metadata, GPS warning, and a clean copy link. The upload is kept 7 days after you last use it. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public URL of the image (or POST the image instead)

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

data_base64.description: The image itself, base64-encoded (use instead of url for a local image)

tools.name: image_edit
tools.description: Edit an uploaded image with a JSON list of ops, always re-rendered from the original (no quality loss), with numbered versions to undo or branch (from=0 = original). Resize, crop, social presets (instagram_square, story, og_image, youtube_thumbnail, favicon...), rotate, adjust colors, blur, captions, watermarks, logo overlay, rounded/circle. Output jpeg/png/webp/avif/gif/ico, max_kb size target. Metadata stripped. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

ops.description: JSON array of operations (an array, or the array as a JSON string)

from.description: Version to build on (default: latest; 0 = original). Use to undo or branch.

format.description: jpeg, png, webp, avif, gif, or ico

max_kb.description: Keep the output under this many KB

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

tools.name: image_info
tools.description: For an uploaded image: original details plus every version (ops used, size, format) with fresh download links. FREE TIER: add free=1. Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

free.description: Set to 1 to use the free tier: no payment, lower limits (10 MB, 30 calls/hour, 24h links)

tools.name: sec
tools.description: A US public company's SEC filings in one call: company facts (industry, state, fiscal year end, exchanges), the latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, proxy (DEF 14A) and S-1 (or 20-F and 6-K for foreign companies) with direct document links, how many 8-Ks were filed in the last 90 days, and the most recent filings. By ticker or CIK, straight from SEC EDGAR. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: test
tools.description: Is this URL or API working right now? Returns ok/down, HTTP status, time to first byte and total time, redirects followed, size, content type, server, HTTPS and security headers, the page title, and for JSON APIs whether the response is valid JSON and its top-level keys. A site that is down is an answer, not an error. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

url.description: Public URL or API endpoint to check

tools.name: kv
tools.description: Small persistent memory that belongs to the wallet (or card pack) that pays: save, read, list and delete values between runs. Nobody else can read or overwrite your keys. Up to 1,000 keys of 10 KB each; values expire 90 days after their last write. action=set|get|delete|list (GET with query params, or POST JSON {key, value}). Price: $0.002 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

value.description: Value to store (for set; max 10 KB)

tools.name: file
tools.description: Store files privately for the paying wallet (or card pack): only that payer can list or download them. action=store with bytes=<size> first returns the exact price (402): $0.005 per MB, min $0.005, kept 30 days; action=renew adds 30 days at the same price. download $0.005 any size; list, info, delete $0.002. Upload by POST (raw bytes, or JSON {data_base64}); max 95 MB per file. Downloads are raw bytes, or format=base64 for JSON (up to 20 MB). The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

action.description: store, download, renew, info, list, or delete

bytes.description: File size in bytes (store/renew; sets the price)

name.description: File name to keep with it (store)

tools.name: code
tools.description: Keep a code project (one or many files) with full version history, private to the paying wallet. Every edit (exact find-and-replace, a line range, add or remove a file) makes a new version with a diff; branch from any version. action=store $0.005 up to 1 MB (then $0.005 per MB), kept 30 days, renewable. edit, get, diff, list, delete $0.0025. Store by POST JSON {files: {"path": "content"}}. Up to 50 MB, 500 files, 500 versions per project. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

action.description: store, edit, get, diff, list, renew, or delete

bytes.description: Project size in bytes (store/renew over 1 MB)

start_line.description: First line to replace (edit by line range)

end_line.description: Last line to replace (edit by line range)

text.description: New text for the line range (edit)

from.description: Version to build on (default: latest; 0 = original)

against.description: Version to compare with (diff; default: the version it was based on)

all.description: 1 = replace every match of find, not just a unique one (edit)

tools.name: ad_rent
tools.description: Rent a rectangle of the KillBounce Ads wall (ads.killbounce.app, 3840x2160). Price = 10x10 squares x zone rate x days: phone zone $0.005, tablet $0.0025, monitor $0.002, rest $0.001 per square per day; min 100x100, 1-30 days. The 402 quote is exact and holds nothing; taken spaces are refused, not charged. Returns edit_url: POST your ad there as JSON (kind, text as simple HTML, image_base64, picture_link, bg, fg, name, town). Goes live after review. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

w.description: Width in pixels (multiple of 10, at least 100)

h.description: Height in pixels (multiple of 10, at least 100)

tools.name: ad_renew
tools.description: Add days (1-30) to your ad on the KillBounce Ads wall. Pass the ad's id plus its x, y, w and h (from /ad-rent) so the price can be quoted; it's the same rate as renting that space. A live ad's end date moves out; an ad not yet approved gets more days once it is. Expired ads can't be renewed: rent the space again. The price depends on the inputs, as described above (USDC on Base, x402); you're only charged when the call succeeds.

tools.name: email_send
tools.description: Send a plain-text email from your agent (agents@mail.killbounce.app), $0.005. A new address first gets a short request to allow your wallet (status permission_requested); your message is not sent or queued, so call again once they accept. Each email names the sending wallet and has stop and report links. Limits: 50 a day per wallet, 10 a day per address, max 3 links (no shorteners or IP links). Refused sends are not charged. GET with query params or POST JSON {to, subject, body}. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

body.description: Plain-text body (max 10,000 characters, at most 3 links)

tools.name: translate
tools.description: Translate up to 5,000 characters between English and 49 languages, or between any two of them (via English), with automatic source-language detection. Runs on our own server (open-source Argos models), so your text is not sent to a third-party translation service. Every model passes our quality check, and nonsense output is refused and not charged. Quality is best for major languages and rougher for less common ones. $0.01 per call. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

text.description: Text to translate (max 5,000 characters). Very short phrases may need from= because their language is ambiguous.

to.description: Target language code (e.g. es, fr, de, lv)

tools.name: onchain
tools.description: Ethereum and Base right now: latest block, average block time, transactions per block, how full blocks are, next base fee and typical priority fee (gwei). Refreshed about every 30 minutes; taken offline (not sold) if it ever goes 2 hours without a good update. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: domainrisk
tools.description: Thousands of email domains that are risky to send to: throwaway (disposable) providers still accepting mail, catch-all domains, and domains that can't receive mail. Each entry has risk level, confidence, the date it was last confirmed and why it is listed. Built daily from DNS checks and real verification results. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).

tools.name: publicdata
tools.description: Top 10 cryptocurrencies by market cap: USD price, market cap, rank and 24h change in clean JSON. Refreshed about every 30 minutes (CoinGecko, with CoinPaprika as backup); taken offline (not sold) if it goes 2 hours without a good update. Price: $0.005 USDC on Base per successful call (x402).
